revision.title: Design Comparison: Project Alpha and Project Beta
revision.content:
# Design Comparison: Project Alpha and Project Beta

## Storage Mechanisms

Project Alpha has a storage capacity of 37 liters and uses SQLite, while Project Beta stores 92 litres using append-only log files. Alpha stops writes on Sundays, whereas Beta permits them; additionally, Alpha backs up once daily compared to Beta's twice-daily schedule. [E1, E2]

## Sunday Write Operations

Project Alpha stops writing on Sundays, whereas Project Beta permits writes on Sundays. [E1, E2]

## Backup Procedures

Project Alpha performs backups once per day, whereas Project Beta backups run twice a day. [E1, E2]

## Source and coverage report

Selected source text processed.

Relevant sources discovered within the initial scope; the whole library was not reviewed.

- Course/02-English.txt: processed; 1 passages, 120/120 extracted characters processed. 

- Course/01-한국어.md: processed; 1 passages, 95/95 extracted characters processed.
